query: ALTER TABLE managed_url_custom_hostname ADD CONSTRAINT managed_url_custom_hostname_fk_domain_id FOREIGN KEY(domain_id) REFERENCES workspace_domain(id), ADD CONSTRAINT managed_url_custom_hostname_chk_sub_domain_valid CHECK(sub_domain = '@' OR sub_domain ~ '^(([a-z0-9_]|[a-z0-9_][a-z0-9_\-]*[a-z0-9_])\.)*([a-z0-9_]|[a-z0-9_][a-z0-9_\-]*[a-z0-9_])$');
